verdicts.reason: A is just the original shrunk into a narrow strip in the centre of the banner, with roughly 85% of the canvas left as dead white space. Its 'LOVE. CARE. KIDS.' headline is tiny and the thin yellow frame is barely visible, so it fails fit-to-format and readability. B at least rearranges the design left to right with a readable headline block and a larger photo, but it is broken too: an empty outlined frame sits alone in the middle, a stray clipped yellow bar sits at the top-right edge, and the headline, frame and photo float as unrelated fragments separated by large gaps.
